hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: When the user invokes any Meta Social Technologies Developer skill (app-health-check, webhook-setup, app-review-prep, debug-webhooks, compliance-check, api-health, api-integration, search-docs, debug-access-token, whatsapp-business-integration), ensure the Meta Social Technologies MCP server is connected. MCP tools may be lazily loaded: before deciding a tool is unavailable, call ToolSearch for the exact expected `mcp__devtools__devtools_*` tool and use it if returned. Only if ToolSearch returns no matching tool should you instruct the user to run `/mcp` and connect to the devtools server. Meta Social Technologies MCP was formerly named Meta Developer Tools MCP; the server id is still `devtools` and its tools are still prefixed `devtools_`. The whatsapp-business-integration skill additionally requires the WhatsApp Business Tools MCP server (id `whatsapp_business_tools`, tools prefixed `whatsapp_biz_`); check for it the same way and, if it is missing, tell the user to add it to their MCP config (`https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools`) and connect it before starting — that skill cannot run on one server alone.
